description: This source file defines the CategoriesProvider class, which manages a list of categories, providing CRUD operations and state management for a Flutter application. It interacts with a CategoryRepository for data persistence and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: CategoriesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages a list of categories, providing methods to load, add, update, and remove categories, with state management and error handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads categories from the repository, optionally filtered by type, updating internal list and notifying listeners.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new category via the repository, adds it to the list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing category via the repository, updates the list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a category by ID via the repository and updates the list accordingly.
